items.en: I apologize.
Excuse me, I am late.
I made a mistake.
He/She apologized to me.
Please forgive me.
I will not do this again.
He/She accepted my apology.
items.translit: U ma'zerat-e ma rā qabul kard.

items.en: I lost the house key.
My book got lost.
I searched everywhere.

items.dari: بالاخره کیف خود را پیدا کردم.
items.en: Finally I found my bag.
items.translit: Belakhera kif-e khod rā paidā kardam.

items.en: My mobile phone was at home.
I was very worried.
Please be careful with your things.
Last night the power went out.
We sat in the dark.
I lit a candle.

items.dari: برق بعد از دو ساعت آمد.
items.en: The power came back after two hours.
items.translit: Barq ba'd az do sā'at āmad.

items.en: Without electricity, work was hard.
The neighbors also had no power.
Now there is always power.

items.dari: من یک مهارت جدید یاد گرفتم.
items.en: I learned a new skill.
items.translit: Man yak mahārat-e jadid yād gereftam.

items.en: Learning English was hard.
I practice every day.
My teacher was patient.
Now I can speak better.
A lot of practice is important.

items.dari: من می‌خواهم مهارت‌های بیشتر یاد بگیرم.
items.en: I want to learn more skills.
items.translit: Man mikhāham mahārat-hā-ye bishtar yād begiram.

items.dari: دیروز به بازار رفتم و لباس خریدم.
items.en: Yesterday I went to the market and bought clothes.
items.translit: Diroz ba bāzār raftam wa lebās kharidam.

items.dari: هفته گذشته امتحان دادم و نمره خوب گرفتم.
items.en: Last week I took an exam and got a good grade.
items.translit: Hafta-ye gozashta emtehān dādam wa nomra-ye khub gereftam.

items.dari: ما دیشب فیلم دیدیم و بعد غذا خوردیم.
items.en: Last night we watched a film and then ate food.
items.translit: Mā dishab film didim wa ba'd ghazā khordim.

items.dari: پارسال به موزیم رفتم و چیزهای زیادی یاد گرفتم.
items.en: Last year I went to the museum and learned a lot of things.
items.translit: Pārsāl ba muzim raftam wa chiz-hā-ye ziādi yād gereftam.

items.dari: دیروز کلید خود را گم کردم اما بالاخره پیدا کردم.
items.en: Yesterday I lost my key but finally found it.
items.translit: Diroz kelid-e khod rā gom kardam ammā belakhera paidā kardam.

items.dari: آخر هفته به کوه رفتیم و عکس گرفتیم.
items.en: On the weekend we went to the mountains and took photos.
items.translit: Ākher-e hafta ba koh raftim wa aks gereftim.

items.dari: من از این سفر خیلی خوشحال شدم.
items.en: I became very happy from this trip.
items.translit: Man az in safar khaili khoshhāl shodam.

items.dari: به نظر من این کتاب جالب است.
items.en: In my opinion, this book is interesting.
items.translit: Ba nazar-e man in kitāb jāleb ast.

items.en: Next week I am going to a wedding.

items.dari: هدف من یادگیری زبان انگلیسی است.
items.en: My goal is learning English.
items.translit: Hadaf-e man yādgiri-e zabān-e engelisi ast.

items.en: Tomorrow I must go to the doctor.

items.dari: من فکر می‌کنم کابل از هرات بزرگ‌تر است.
items.en: I think Kabul is bigger than Herat.
items.translit: Man fekr mikonam Kābol az Herāt bozorg-tar ast.

items.dari: آرزوی من سفر به دنیا است.
items.en: My wish is to travel the world.
items.translit: Ārezu-ye man safar ba doniā ast.

items.en: I hope tomorrow the weather will be good.
